items.description: Institutional portfolios operate under investment policy statements that specify asset allocation constraints, often conditioned on market regime information.
items.ai_summary: A neurosymbolic reinforcement learning approach for portfolio allocation uses Monte Carlo sampling to estimate policy compliance with investment mandates and significantly reduces rule violations.

items.title: K2V: Generative Keyframing For Physically Plausible Video Generation
items.description: Video diffusion models are able to generate samples with high-quality appearance and textural qualities. However, content produced by these methods is known to exhibit significant physical errors.
items.ai_summary: K2V is a generative keyframing method that uses a language model to handle physical reasoning and condition a video generation model to produce physically plausible videos.

items.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.description: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering.
items.ai_summary: AgentSSL is a semi-supervised learning framework that frames pipeline design as a program search problem, allowing machine learning agents to leverage unlabeled data and surpass human-engineered baselines.

items.title: BrickFlow: Connectivity-Guided Brick Reconstruction
items.description: Given a set of LEGO parts and an image of an assembled object, our task is to infer the pose of each part to assemble the object.
items.ai_summary: BrickFlow is a connectivity-guided brick reconstruction method that uses an SE(3) flow model and analytic connectivity-field guidance to infer the poses of LEGO parts from an image.

items.title: Learning When Diffusion Language Models Should Regenerate
items.description: Remasking allows diffusion language models to revisit generated text, but effective correction requires knowing when and what to revise. Our diagnosis on Sudoku reveals two gaps.
items.ai_summary: DiVR is a verifier for diffusion language models that predicts whether a generated sequence will reach a correct answer to determine when and what text to regenerate.

items.title: Spatial Foundry: A Multimodal Dataset for Spatial Intelligence
items.description: Spatial intelligence requires connecting visual observations to the geometry, objects, and persistent state of an environment.
items.ai_summary: Spatial Foundry is a multimodal dataset of 5,280 furnished 3D scene configurations with aligned visual, geometric, and temporal data, useful for spatial intelligence and 3D generation research.

items.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
items.description: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it.
items.ai_summary: CoReMem is a cost-internalizing memory framework for coding agents that uses prospective segment valuation to improve task resolution rates while reducing steps and token usage.

items.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
items.description: Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly.
items.ai_summary: Research on meta-learned neural networks demonstrates that their parameter vectors exhibit additive compositional relationships that allow them to implement new functions without direct training.

items.title: Sketching Language Models for Context Attribution
items.description: Context attribution asks how removing parts of a prompt changes a language model's output. We study leave-one-out (LOO) attribution for a prompt of $n$ tokens and a fixed measurement function. Computing all LOO values directly requires $n$ model evaluations.
items.ai_summary: A new sketching algorithm for language model context attribution estimates leave-one-out values efficiently by applying forward differentiation to the backpropagation circuit.

items.title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
items.description: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles.
items.ai_summary: CRAM is a learned energy-based model that solves reasoning puzzles significantly faster and with fewer FLOPs than baseline looped models.

items.title: Quantifying structural stability of transparent models for general insurance pricing
items.description: The short duration of general insurance contracts leads to rapid distributional shifts in the data, warranting regular model updates. This process may yield a post-update model that differs considerably from the pre-update model in both predictions and structure.
items.ai_summary: A proposed mean squared shape function distance metric quantifies the structural stability of functionally transparent machine learning models for insurance pricing.

items.title: Towards a Theory of Learnability via Debate
items.description: Debate has been recently proposed as a training protocol that is hoped to produce more aligned models even as model capabilities scale.
items.ai_summary: An online learning formulation of debate as a training protocol characterizes the learnability of complex functions using a combinatorial dimension.

items.title: FLEX-LBP: Learning Local Binary Patterns with Exact Binary Inference for Texture Classification
items.description: Local Binary Patterns (LBP) remain among the most widely used texture descriptors, from industrial inspection to medical imaging. Yet their radius, sampling angles, color transform and thresholds are fixed by hand for each dataset.
items.ai_summary: FLEX-LBP learns local binary pattern parameters via backpropagation to improve texture classification accuracy while maintaining interpretable hard-binary inference.

items.title: Consistent Video-to-Video Translation via Explicit Correspondences
items.description: Interactive video-to-video applications require real-time generation while maintaining long-range temporal consistency. However, recent methods achieve speed by restricting attention to a fixed-length causal window.
items.ai_summary: Vid2vid-long is a correspondence-based video translation approach that uses patch-level input correspondences to maintain long-range temporal consistency in real-time generation.

items.title: Goal Encoding in LLMs
items.description: We investigate whether and how LLMs encode goals: internal neural representations that precede and guide action, and that are flexible enough to be realized through many different execution paths.
items.ai_summary: Research into goal encoding in large language models localizes causal sub-goal representations in sparse attention heads and proposes a non-recurrent goal-seeking account for action execution.

items.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
items.description: On-device inference requires kernels that make effective use of local accelerators. Efficient training and evaluation of models that generate Apple Metal kernels benefit from native macOS tools and concurrent agent sessions.
items.ai_summary: Metal Sandbox is an open-source infrastructure for Apple Silicon that combines file access, command execution, and scheduling to improve GPU coding agent throughput.

items.title: Negative-Only Policy Optimization for One-Sided Verifiable Rewards
items.description: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically relies on a verifier that can reliably judge whether sampled solutions are correct. However, in many realistic settings, complete verification is generally unavailable, while cheap checks can only falsify failures.
items.ai_summary: Negative-Only Policy Optimization is a reinforcement learning method that improves performance on code, logic, and math tasks by updating policies using only verified negative examples.

items.title: Gemini 4 Hydrogen and Orchestrator
items.description: Trending on Hacker News from antigravity.google. 382 points and 105 comments.
items.ai_summary: Google rolls out Gemini 4 Hydrogen inside Google Antigravity alongside an Orchestrator model option to balance quality, efficiency, and latency on long-horizon tasks.

items.title: Synthesis Smuggling: Maliciously Hiding Inferred Personal Attributes in LLM Outputs
items.description: We propose Synthesis Smuggling, a novel threat model in which an adversarial LLM infers sensitive information about a user from routine assistance-seeking interactions and steganographically encodes that into innocuous-looking model-generated content.
items.ai_summary: Synthesis Smuggling is a threat model where an adversarial large language model infers sensitive user attributes from conversations and steganographically encodes them into generated content.

items.title: LiveGeo: Benchmarking Geographic Agents in Continuously Evolving Worlds
items.description: We introduce GeoWorld, a controllable and continuously evolving geographic environment platform for LLM agents, and LiveGeo, a benchmark for evaluating reliable decision-making in real-world geographic environments using GeoWorld.
items.ai_summary: LiveGeo is a benchmark and platform that evaluates the ability of large language models to make reliable decisions in continuously evolving geographic environments.

items.title: Programming Quantum Circuit Parameters with Large Language Models
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated the ability to generate parameters for variational quantum circuits without conventional optimization. However, the conditions under which this approach is effective remain unclear.
items.ai_summary: Research into programming quantum circuit parameters using large language models finds that physical structure helps generate low-energy configurations, while iterative optimization provides limited benefit.

items.title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
items.description: Modern automated heuristic discovery (AHD) systems increasingly rival hand-crafted heuristics by leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) to iteratively mutate and refine solutions.
items.ai_summary: Ballad is an online bandit algorithm that orchestrates an ensemble of large language models for automated heuristic discovery by learning to route tasks across models.

items.title: Objects as Addresses: Instance Binding in Vision Transformer Attention
items.description: Humans naturally parse visual scenes into coherent individual objects rather than scattered features, a capability cognitive science calls object binding.
items.ai_summary: Analysis of Vision Transformer attention reveals that instance separation is driven by query-key relations that direct patches of the same object to shared attention addresses.

items.title: When Both Sides Adapt: The Challenges of Evaluating Interactive LLM Systems
items.description: In interactive systems where users engage with LLMs, users are adaptive and, after observing LLM responses, can change their prompting strategy, as well as the type and difficulty of subsequent tasks.
items.ai_summary: Study of interactive large language model systems reveals that user adaptivity causes offline benchmarks and live experiments to rank models differently.

items.title: Al-Ghasali: A Computational Framework for Simulating Islamic Jurisprudential Rulings via Finite State Automata and Large Language Models
items.description: This paper presents Al Ghasali, a computational framework designed to formalize and simulate Islamic jurisprudential (Fiqh) rulings.
items.ai_summary: Al-Ghasali is a computational framework that combines deterministic finite state automata with large language models to simulate Islamic jurisprudential rulings while preventing hallucinations.

items.title: Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
items.description: Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation.
items.ai_summary: Mathematical analysis of knowledge distillation reveals that its primary benefit is faster optimization speed rather than improved generalization for student models.

items.title: Linear Regression with Self-Selection Bias in Polynomial Time
items.description: We revisit the problem of estimating $k$ linear regressors with self-selection bias in $n$ dimensions up to error $\varepsilon$ with the maximum self-selection criterion, as introduced by Cherapanamjeri, Daskalakis, Ilyas, and Zampetakis [CDIZ23, STOC].
items.ai_summary: Researchers propose a polynomial-time algorithm for estimating linear regressors with self-selection bias, improving upon prior algorithms with exponential dependencies.

items.title: Sheaf-Inspired Structured Scoring Extensions of LightGCN for Collaborative Filtering
items.description: Graph-based collaborative filtering learns user and item representations by propagating embeddings over a user--item interaction graph. We investigate a modular, sheaf-inspired scoring extension placed on top of a three-layer LightGCN backbone.
items.ai_summary: Researchers investigate a sheaf-inspired structured scoring extension placed on top of a LightGCN backbone for graph-based collaborative filtering.

items.title: Data Archive for 2D and 3D Electrical Impedance Tomography with moderate conductivity contrast phantoms
items.description: This document describes open Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) measurement data that were collected from biomedical imaging inspired phantoms with moderate conductivity contrasts.
items.ai_summary: This data archive provides open Electrical Impedance Tomography measurements from biomedical phantoms to help develop and test image reconstruction algorithms.

items.title: Combinatorial Bernoulli Factories with Polynomially Many Coins
items.description: We provide an efficient implementation of combinatorial Bernoulli factories. Such a factory turns coins of unknown biases $x$ into a random vertex of a polytope $P$ whose mean is exactly $x$.
items.ai_summary: Researchers introduce an efficient implementation of combinatorial Bernoulli factories that converts unknown coin biases into a random vertex of a polytope.

items.title: Scalable Conversational Assessment: Chat-Based Exams with a Two-Agent LLM Pipeline
items.description: Oral exams are compelling because (1) students can be asked to provide their reasoning for an answer and (2) their interactive nature permits follow-up questions to resolve ambiguous answers. But oral exams scale poorly.
items.ai_summary: This study presents a two-agent LLM pipeline that conducts interactive, text-based oral exams to assess student arguments while preventing leaks.

items.title: Introducing Feedback Delays to Non-Delayed Adversarial MDPs: Optimal $\sqrt S$ and $\sqrt K$ Dependencies in Tabular and Linear AMDPs
items.description: We study regret minimization in episodic Adversarial Markov Decision Processes (AMDPs) with unknown transitions and bandit feedback.
items.ai_summary: Researchers propose a technique using voluntary feedback delays and geometric resampling to improve regret minimization in adversarial Markov decision processes.

items.title: Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Sparse Convolution
items.description: Deep neural networks for image processing are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained edge devices such as drones, medical systems, and smartphones, where limited computational resources and memory bandwidth pose significant challenges for efficient inference.
items.ai_summary: This paper analyzes the performance characteristics of sparse convolution and proposes techniques that achieve up to 1.65x speedups on modern hardware accelerators.

items.title: MALNISI-Infused Graph Construction and Weighted Contrastive Loss based GAT for Unsupervised Representation Learning in HSI
items.description: Hyperspectral images (HSI) possess discriminating spectral characteristics with respect to land utilization due to high-dimensional information.
items.ai_summary: Method that constructs hyperspectral image graphs using a local spectral index and a weighted contrastive loss to improve unsupervised representation learning.

items.title: Physically Interpretable Basin Selection in Discrete-Variable Origami Design
items.description: Automatic differentiation has enabled rapid progress on continuous-variable mechanical design problems, but gradient-based optimization still struggles with discrete variables.
items.ai_summary: Optimization framework that uses initialization priors and loss penalties to improve discrete-variable origami design and mechanical stiffness.

items.title: eDMD: Endpoint Distribution Matching for Few-Step Diffusion Distillation
items.description: Distribution matching distillation (DMD) has emerged as a leading paradigm for distilling diffusion models into few-step students, where an auxiliary fake score model tracks the student's distribution and the discrepancy between the teacher and fake predictions drives the…
items.ai_summary: Diffusion distillation method that trains a shared fake model exclusively on student endpoint outputs to ensure accurate distribution matching.

items.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
items.description: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings.
items.ai_summary: Training mechanism that adds an effective-rank regularizer to LoRA adapters to maximize capacity utilization and reduce the learning-forgetting trade-off.

items.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.description: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves.
items.ai_summary: Two-part benchmark that evaluates background alignment and object errors in reference-based UAV video stabilization over dynamic urban scenes.

items.title: Cortex-FL: Agent-Mediated Collaboration for Federated Learning
items.description: Federated learning (FL) enables independent data owners to train models collaboratively without centralizing raw data.
items.ai_summary: Agent-native federated learning system that translates natural language objectives into collaborative training tasks and managed agreements.

items.title: Neural Render Proxies for Interactive and Differentiable Lighting
items.description: Within the CG animation production pipeline, the challenges artists tackle in Lighting can be immense.
items.ai_summary: Neural render proxy framework that decouples path sampling and emission computation to enable interactive and differentiable scene relighting.

items.title: Kapso – Iterative learning from enterprise data
items.description: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data.

items.title: Validation-Guided Prompt Selection for Differential Morphing Attack Detection
items.description: Differential morphing attack detection (D-MAD) compares a trusted live capture with a document image that may contain a facial morph.
items.ai_summary: Validation-guided prompt selection method that optimizes frozen vision-language models for improved differential morphing attack detection accuracy.

items.title: SpotDiff: A Plug-and-Play Framework for Zero-Shot Change Detection in Remote Sensing Imagery
items.description: Remote sensing change detection usually relies on large collections of temporally aligned, pixel-level annotations, which limits its scalability across regions, imaging platforms and application domains.
items.ai_summary: Training-free change detection framework that combines vision foundation models and feature upsampling for zero-shot remote sensing analysis.

items.title: Parsed, Plausible, Wrong: Output Format Controls Silent Errors in Small-Model Semantic Parsing
items.description: A small fine-tuned parser that emits a well-formed but wrong tree fails silently: nothing downstream can tell. We ask whether the output format, a free design choice, controls how often this happens.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation study showing that using word-based output formats reduces silent errors and improves accuracy in small-model semantic parsing.

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
items.description: A decision model that acts poorly can still teach reinforcement learning policies effectively by judging complete action trajectories, improving success on ALFWorld and WebShop.

items.title: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
items.description: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored.
items.ai_summary: Unified framework and dataset suite called UAV-Flow provides benchmarks and learning algorithms for language-guided, object-relative UAV flight maneuvers.

items.title: Symmetry in Time: A Representation Theory of Linear Recurrent Memory
items.description: State space models (SSMs) are an emerging alternative to Transformers.
items.ai_summary: Representation theory of linear recurrent memory explains state-tracking limits in state space models and introduces HyperSSM, which adds quaternion channels to solve complex group tasks.

items.title: Cited but Unused: Parametric Provenance in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
items.description: Retrieval-augmented generation systems attach citations to attribute claims to their sources. These citations frequently misstate provenance, and standard verification cannot detect this.
items.ai_summary: Study on retrieval-augmented generation finds that a notable fraction of citations derive from parametric memory rather than retrieved context, and proposes a provenance-separation method.

items.title: AeroZoo: A Benchmark of Well-Posed Flow Problems for Foundation Models of Aerodynamics
items.description: Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain.
items.ai_summary: AeroZoo benchmark provides thousands of time-mean RANS flow solutions and boundary-condition tasks to evaluate and train neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics.

items.title: HiVE-VQA: Hierarchical Interaction via Volumetric Embedding for Video Quality Assessment
items.description: The proliferation of user-generated video content has made accurate and robust no-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) a highly important challenge.
items.ai_summary: HiVE-VQA framework uses a frozen video foundation model with hierarchical depth-wise feature fusion to perform no-reference video quality assessment.

items.title: Enhancing Preference Detection using Eye Movement Cascade and Multilayer Combinatorial Fusion
items.description: Understanding how visual attention influences human preference formation is a fundamental problem in consumer behavior and cognitive science. In this work, we investigate how eye movement patterns can be used to predict preference decisions when subjects compare two alternatives.
items.ai_summary: Multi-layer combinatorial fusion framework combines machine learning classifiers using eye movement data to improve the accuracy of human preference prediction.

items.title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
items.description: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data.
items.ai_summary: Convex-analytic reformulation transforms data poisoning attacks on logistic regression into a form that yields stronger dual bounds when solved with optimization software.

items.title: ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
items.description: A foundational principle of physics is that all coordinate systems are equally valid: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the origin or orientation of the frame, nor on the units or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model.
items.ai_summary: ISLA is a coordinate-free, measure-weighted transformer for boundary-driven PDEs that maintains invariance to rigid motions, reflections, and unit changes for aerodynamic forecasting.

items.title: Support-Constrained Offline Policy Improvement for Pediatric ECMO from Limited Clinical Data
items.description: Managing children on ECMO (Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation) requires balancing short-term physiological stability with the long-term goal of preventing neurological injury.
items.ai_summary: Support-Constrained Fitted Q-Iteration is an offline reinforcement learning framework that safely improves pediatric ECMO treatment policies by restricting optimization to supported states.

items.title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
items.description: Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol.
items.ai_summary: FedBrew is a research codebase for federated learning that uses automated configuration, data partitioning, and scientific checks to ensure reproducible experiments.

items.title: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation: Differentiable Length Control for Concise Clinical Reasoning in Smaller Language Models
items.description: Smaller language models (SLMs) make it feasible to deploy clinical natural language processing where large proprietary models are too costly, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning allows them to be specialised on commodity hardware.
items.ai_summary: Parameter-Efficient Conciseness Adaptation is a training method that reduces response length and improves diagnostic accuracy in smaller language models by adding a single differentiable conciseness term to the QLoRA objective.

items.title: STeP-C: Real-Time Neural Compression for Distributed Fiber-Optic Sensing at Scale
items.description: Distributed fiber-optic sensing (DFOS) technologies such as Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) generate continuous, high-resolution spatio-temporal data at rates exceeding hundreds of megabytes per second, creating severe challenges for real-time storage and transmission.
items.ai_summary: STeP-C is a real-time neural compression framework that combines spatial encoding, temporal prediction, and parallel arithmetic coding to reduce data size and transmission bottlenecks in distributed fiber-optic sensing systems.

items.title: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
items.description: DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit.
items.ai_summary: An energy pixels approach uses the spread of affinities in a naive DNA-encoded library to estimate the complexity needed for second-generation libraries to successfully train high-resolution binding models.

items.title: Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
items.description: We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD).
items.ai_summary: A mathematical framework establishes contraction criteria for the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy, unifying existing kernel results and identifying new contraction-inducing kernels.

items.title: CapLite: Prompt-Injection Defense for Small Language Model Agents without Model-Written Security Artifacts
items.description: Enforcement defenses against prompt injection, such as CaMeL, Progent, IPIGuard and DRIFT, ask the agent's own model to write a security artifact (a program, a privilege policy, a dependency graph or a constraint list) that code then enforces.
items.ai_summary: CapLite is a prompt-injection defense framework for small language model agents that derives security policies from tool schemas and guarantees write integrity without relying on agent-written security artifacts.

items.title: Designing Institutions for Autonomous AI
items.description: As autonomous AI agents increasingly interact in persistent populations, their collective capabilities and alignment depend not only on individual models, but also on the institutions governing their interactions. Yet AI research has largely focused on individual agents.
items.ai_summary: Institutional design principles establish a research framework for governing interactions among autonomous AI agents to sustain cooperation, ensure reliable collective judgments, and maintain accountability.

items.title: Spatiotemporal learning improves quantification of pore-space evolution and fluid displacement
items.description: Pore-space evolution and fluid displacement influence how rocks transmit and store fluids, affecting geological carbon storage, underground hydrogen storage and groundwater contaminant transport.
items.ai_summary: A transformer-based 4D segmentation framework combines spatial and temporal image sequences to improve the quantification of pore-space evolution, mineral dissolution, and fluid displacement in rocks.

items.title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
items.description: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision.
items.ai_summary: SALA is a semantically aligned latent action framework that uses language descriptions of unpaired human and robot videos to establish cross-embodiment correspondence for training embodied foundation models.

items.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
items.description: We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample.
items.ai_summary: An oracle-efficient algorithm achieves near-optimal expected regret for adversarial contextual bandits by perturbing policy scores using optimized Laplace noise and auxiliary contexts.

items.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
items.description: Memory decides which LLMs an edge device runs, and how fast: capacity on a $4$ GB Jetson Nano, bandwidth on an $8$ GB Jetson Orin Nano Super.
items.ai_summary: LazyWeights is an on-demand decoding approach that combines tuned quantization, lossless Huffman coding, and a dedicated ASIC decoder unit to reduce memory footprint, latency, and energy consumption for edge large language models.

items.title: Disentangling Spurious Correlations: How IRM Handles Diverse Shortcuts in Text Classification
items.description: In NLP, models trained via Empirical Risk Minimization (ERM) often exploit spurious correlations, such as dialectal markers, at the expense of robust linguistic features, thereby degrading their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization.
items.ai_summary: Causality-driven framework that evaluates Invariant Risk Minimization for text classification, showing it can successfully suppress various shortcuts and mitigate realistic textual biases.

items.title: Predicting Ethanol Drinking Status from Nonhuman Primate Liver Histology: A Proof of Concept for Parameter-efficient Fine-tuning in Few-Shot Vision-Language Modeling
items.description: Combining vision-language models (VLMs) with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) offers a promising approach to few-shot whole-slide image (WSI) classification in computational pathology.
items.ai_summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning method using vision-language adapters for few-shot whole-slide image classification, demonstrating improved accuracy in predicting animal health status from histology.

items.title: TuMAP: A Dual-View, Morphotype-Aware Pathomics Pipeline for Quantifying Renal Tubular Remodeling
items.description: Quantifying disease-associated renal tubular remodeling is challenging because tubular appearances are heterogeneous.
items.ai_summary: Tubular Morphotype-Aware Pathomics pipeline that combines foundation-model representations and statistical inference to quantify heterogeneous disease-associated renal tubular remodeling from kidney biopsy slides.

items.title: Joint Null-Space Projection for Data-Free Model Merging
items.description: Merging independently fine-tuned checkpoints into a single multi-task model requires no data, no labels, and no gradient steps.
items.ai_summary: Joint Null-Space Projection method that merges independently fine-tuned neural network checkpoints by removing subspace interference, achieving high data-free classification accuracy.

items.title: A Compact xDAWN-Guided Spatio-Temporal Network with Filter-Bank Convolution for P300 Detection
items.description: P300-based brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) enable communication by decoding stimulus-evoked EEG responses into character selections without requiring voluntary motor output.
items.ai_summary: Compact deep learning architecture combining xDAWN spatial filtering and convolutional feature learning to detect P300 waves in EEG data for brain-computer interfaces.

items.title: Speed-to-Power Dominates Energy Costs for AI Data Centers: Technoeconomic Analysis of Powering AI in the Continental United States
items.description: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving demand for new data centers at large scale and on short deployment timelines.
items.ai_summary: Technoeconomic framework for analyzing AI data center energy infrastructure, showing that deployment speed rather than unit energy cost dictates the preferred power option.

items.title: Optimal Single-History Tokenization Disambiguation for Provably Secure Linguistic Steganography
items.description: Provably secure linguistic steganography assumes that the receiver recovers the sender's tokens, but a text channel delivers only text, and ambiguous tokenizations break extraction.
items.ai_summary: Coin projection scheme for linguistic steganography that preserves language model tokenization distributions and converts text entropy into secure message bits.

items.title: SALT: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer for Single-Temporal Cross-Dataset Structural Localization in Remote Sensing
items.description: Change detection in remote sensing conventionally relies on spatially aligned bi-temporal imagery, which may be unavailable or unreliable in practical scenarios.
items.ai_summary: State-Aligned Low-Rank Transfer framework that leverages frozen pretrained backbones and low-rank adaptation to perform single-temporal structural change detection in remote sensing.

items.title: Reasoning Supervision and Capability Retention in LoRA Domain Adaptation
items.description: Fine-tuning foundation models on financial data has a wide range of applications, including identifying event types from news, monitoring risk and compliance language, and answering questions over filings and earnings calls.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation study examining Qwen3-8B fine-tuning via LoRA on financial data, showing how different training regimes impact in-domain performance and general capability retention.

items.title: Evaluation of Music Version Retrieval Methods for Setlist Identification in Live Concerts
items.description: Automatic setlist identification aims to identify the songs performed in live concert recordings by matching noisy and variable-quality audio against a database of reference tracks.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation study on setlist identification showing that compact neural audio embeddings achieve high retrieval performance for matching live concert recordings against reference tracks.

items.title: Discovering Effective Agent Memory Designs through Program Evolution
items.description: Program evolution provides a promising approach to discover agent memory designs and study the choices underlying their effectiveness.
items.ai_summary: Framework called MAPE evolves agent memory programs from minimal seeds using a standardized interface and diagnosis-proposal loop to improve accuracy while lowering serving costs.

items.title: An Invariant Neural-Network Eddy-Viscosity Closure with Iterative Solver Coupling for Molten Salt Fast Reactor Thermal-Hydraulics
items.description: System thermal-hydraulics codes such as the System Analysis Module (SAM) close turbulence on coarse meshes with algebraic zero-equation mixing-length models.
items.ai_summary: Invariant neural-network eddy-viscosity closure is developed for the System Analysis Module to improve thermal-hydraulic predictions in molten salt fast reactors.

items.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
items.description: Large foundation models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.1 have recently been shown to control robots directly from visual observations. They nevertheless remain brittle on long-horizon, contact-rich tasks in real-world environments.

items.title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
items.description: Online conformal risk control (OCRC) enables reliable uncertainty quantification in machine learning by converting model outputs into prediction sets with long-term risk guarantees.
items.ai_summary: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control framework jointly allocates limited tracking feedback capacity and constructs prediction sets to provide reliable long-term risk guarantees.

items.title: Evaluating Pretrained Language Semantics for Structured EHR Prediction Tasks
items.description: Structured Electronic Health Records (EHR) models typically treat each clinical concept as a dataset-specific token, discarding the natural-language semantics associated with the event.
items.ai_summary: Method called tEHR adapts pretrained causal language models for longitudinal electronic health record prediction by using natural language descriptions and two-stage model adaptation.

items.title: Auditing AI peer reviewers: a benchmark on real scientific papers
items.description: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited.
items.ai_summary: Benchmark injects objective errors into real scientific papers to evaluate the detection rates and false-positive rates of various LLM-based peer reviewer systems.

items.title: AURA 2.0: From User-Driven Responses to Model-Initiated Conversations in Streaming Video
items.description: Most AI assistants respond only when prompted, remaining silent even when events in the video stream offer meaningful opportunities for conversation.
items.ai_summary: Streaming video large language model named AURA 2.0 introduces model-initiated conversations, stream-aware tool calling, and interactive visual grounding for enhanced user interactions.

items.title: Infrastructure for Verifiable AI: Where Proof Costs Go and How Hardware Can Help
items.description: Users of artificial intelligence services, including those powered by large language models and other transformer-based models, need assurance that inference and training follow the declared computation without exposing private models or data.
items.ai_summary: Four-layer framework links verifiable AI workloads, proof systems, cryptographic kernels, and hardware platforms to analyze zero-knowledge proof generation costs for neural networks.

items.title: From Delegation to Coordination: Learning Efficient Multi-Agent Deep Research
items.description: Multi-agent deep-research systems use delegation to parallelize search and keep long tool traces out of the main agent's context.
items.ai_summary: Joint main-agent-subagent training framework called LEAD-RL uses contribution-aware credit assignment to improve the quality and efficiency of multi-agent deep research systems.

items.title: Prevalence Bounds for Edited Watermarked Text: Power Envelopes and Calibration Sensitivity
items.description: Watermark detectors decide whether one document came from a watermarked language model. Auditors often need a different number: the share of a corpus that did.
items.ai_summary: Method derives prevalence bounds and power envelopes for edited watermarked text to estimate the share of a corpus generated by a watermarked language model.

items.title: Your Vision Foundation Model Is Secretly an EEG Foundation Model
items.description: Electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models are pretrained on thousands of hours of recordings, yet their frozen features transfer poorly to downstream tasks, and this transfer does not consistently improve with larger models or more pretraining data.
items.ai_summary: Method named SeeEEG renders electroencephalography signals as images to use frozen vision foundation models as effective encoders for downstream brain-computer interface tasks.

items.title: Similar but Not Redundant: Embedding-Gated Refinement for High-Granularity Topic Models
items.description: High-granularity topic modelling extracts hundreds of niche topics from a corpus, yet this regime is rarely studied and is more commonly framed as a failure mode: "over-clustering," in which coherent themes fragment into redundant subtopics.
items.ai_summary: Embedding-gated iterative merge is a hybrid topic modeling approach that uses embedding similarity and LLM judgment to separate genuinely redundant topics from semantically similar niche topics.

items.title: Temporal Regularized Learning: Self-Supervised Learning Local in Space and Time
items.description: Layer-local self-supervised objectives remove the backward pass between layers, but almost all still compute their loss over a batch of samples and are therefore local in space but not in time.
items.ai_summary: Temporal Regularized Learning is a spatially and temporally local self-supervised learning rule for sequential input streams that uses a VICReg-style objective to enable continuous online learning without backpropagation.

items.title: AI for Biologists: The Knowledge Boundaries of Foundation Models in the Age of Agentic Systems
items.description: Artificial intelligence (AI) is changing how biological research is done. Biological foundation models trained on millions of nucleotides, protein, and single-cell measurements predict protein structures, mutation effects, and cellular responses to genetic perturbations.
items.ai_summary: This review paper examines how foundation models and agentic systems are used in biological research, proposing that five design elements define their reliable knowledge boundaries.

items.title: Anonymous in Name Only: A Critical Review and a Reidentification Exercise on the European Commission's Anonymization Measures for Google Search Data under Article 6(11) of the DMA
items.description: In July 2026, the European Commission (EC) set out the anonymization measures Alphabet must implement to share Google Search data with competing search engines under Article 6(11) of the Digital Markets Act.
items.ai_summary: This paper critically reviews the European Commission's anonymization measures for Google Search data under the Digital Markets Act, demonstrating through empirical attacks that the measures fail to provide formal privacy guarantees.

items.title: Random Exploration is Random
items.description: Decision making often requires balancing exploitation of familiar options with exploration of uncertain alternatives. One strategy for exploration is random exploration, in which choices become more variable and less tied to the option that currently appears best.
items.ai_summary: An analysis of choice variability in the Horizon Task reveals that random exploration in decision-making truly is substantially random and cannot be fully captured by deterministic neural network models.

items.title: Skill Adapter: Personalized Modification and Online Routing of General-Purpose Skills
items.description: Large language model (LLM) agents use external skills to reuse task procedures and experience with tools. General-purpose skills describe shared execution procedures, while specific tool choices, operating practices, and output requirements vary across users.
items.ai_summary: Skill Adapter is a system for large language model agents that personalizes general-purpose skills using execution feedback and routes them online to improve task success rates and reduce execution time.

items.title: An Integrated Architecture for Data-Efficient Real-Time Neural Imitation of Nonlinear Time-Optimal Model Predictive Control
items.description: Nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control (TOMPC) enables highly performant control of constrained systems, but its computational cost prohibits real-time use on fast dynamical systems.
items.ai_summary: Self-informed sampling is a data-efficient expert-sampling strategy that speeds up neural network imitation of nonlinear time-optimal model predictive control by querying the expert only where the policy deviates from time-optimal behavior.

items.title: Entire sig-jump-diffusions, their expected signature and applications to score-based generative modeling
items.description: We develop score-based generative models for time series and standard finite-dimensional data, building on the analytical computation of the expected signature of a new class of jump-diffusions, called entire sig-jump-diffusions.
items.ai_summary: This paper develops score-based generative models for time series and finite-dimensional data by computing the expected signature of a new class of jump-diffusions through linear ordinary differential equations.

items.title: AnalogLayoutWorld: An Open Benchmark for Agentic Analog Layout Design
items.description: Coding agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in software development, yet their ability to tackle long-horizon engineering tasks governed by physical constraints remains less understood.
items.ai_summary: AnalogLayoutWorld is an open-source benchmark with 40 expert-reviewed tasks designed to evaluate coding agents on end-to-end analog circuit layout generation governed by physical constraints.

items.title: Primer: An AI Framework for Instructor-Centered Educational Simulation Creation
items.description: Educational simulations are a well-established pedagogical technique that gives learners opportunities to apply knowledge, respond to challenges, and reflect on their performance.
items.ai_summary: Primer is an open-source, LLM-agnostic AI framework that helps instructors create adaptive educational simulations using a multi-agent system driven by instructional intent.

items.title: ElasticDino: Dense Semantic Features Using Elastic Deformations
items.description: Vision transformers (ViTs) serve as the backbone for countless vision tasks, including dense prediction tasks, such as segmentation and depth estimation, even though the quadratic complexity of self-attention severely limits feature resolution and induces spatial artifacts.
items.ai_summary: ElasticDino is a lightweight vision transformer adapter that efficiently produces pixel-aligned, high-resolution feature maps for dense downstream prediction tasks like segmentation and depth estimation.

items.title: Compiling Known Rules into Compact Neural Agents: Weight-Space Programming on Unseen Games
items.description: Weight-space programming (WSP) uses language models to construct neural network weights without training. We test whether known game mechanics can be compiled into compact agents that generalise to held-out levels, renderings and start states within a game family.
items.ai_summary: Researchers use language models in a weight-space programming approach to compile game rules directly into compact neural network agents for unseen game families.

items.title: Morphological Simplification in Alzheimer's Disease: Computational Analysis and Identification From Connected Speech
items.description: Purpose: Morphology is often regarded as relatively spared in Alzheimer's disease (AD) and is rarely modeled in connected speech.
items.ai_summary: Automatic morphological measures computed from connected speech can classify Alzheimer's disease with high accuracy, improving prediction performance when combined with BERT models.

items.title: The Value of Thinking: Learning When to Reason in Hybrid Decision Models
items.description: A hybrid decision model routes between implicit single-forward-pass answering and full autoregressive reasoning via a self-routing block trained with calibrated decision policy optimization, reducing token and latency costs while preserving accuracy.

items.title: Lara Mini Base: Language Diversity as a Resource, Not a Trade-off
items.description: General-purpose language models are trained mostly on English: over open models we review, at most, non-English pretraining data makes up only a 12% share. Models built for European languages give them far more, but score well below general-purpose models of the same size.
items.ai_summary: Lara Mini base is a multilingual mixture-of-experts language model trained across 45 languages that achieves high performance on standard, multilingual, math, and code benchmarks.

items.title: A Disease-specific Retinal Aging Biomarker for Predicting Progression to Late Age-related Macular Degeneration
items.description: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) is a leading cause of irreversible vision loss in older adults.
items.ai_summary: Fundus-based AMD age is a disease-specific retinal aging biomarker that improves prognostic precision and risk stratification for patients with age-related macular degeneration.

items.title: SignalAudit-QD: A Reproducible Audit Resource for External Signals in AI-Query Forecasting
items.description: SignalAudit-QD is a reproducible audit resource for testing whether a dated public signal adds information beyond query history in a fixed 20-term U.S. AI panel.
items.ai_summary: SignalAudit-QD provides a reproducible audit resource and evidence schema for testing whether external public signals add predictive information to query-history forecasting models.

items.title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
items.description: Typed System-1 (S1) decision models are increasingly deployed in LLM agents for routing, moderation, and authorization to cut inference cost, yet untrusted context can still manipulate typed outputs and alter execution branches.
items.ai_summary: S1-Evo is a self-evolving framework that generates evidence competition attacks to manipulate typed system-1 decision models used in LLM agents.

items.title: Universal Infectious Disease Forecasting with Mantis 2
items.description: Public health agencies need to anticipate how outbreaks will unfold, when they will peak, and how long demand on health services will remain elevated.
items.ai_summary: Mantis 2 is an infectious disease foundation model combining simulated and observational training data to jointly forecast outbreak variables up to sixteen weeks ahead.

items.title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
items.description: Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge.
items.ai_summary: Ci-proto is a family of time series foundation models based on linear recurrences that achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot forecasting performance with linear computational scaling.

items.title: Kezek: Splitting Mono Two-Person Conversations into Per-Speaker Tracks for Full-Duplex Dialogue Data
items.description: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models learn turn-taking, overlaps and backchannels from conversations recorded with one channel per speaker, but most available conversational audio is a single mono mix.
items.ai_summary: Kezek is a two-stage audio model that splits mono recordings of two-person conversations into separate per-speaker tracks while accurately preserving overlaps and short replies.

items.title: SPADE: Soft Prompts for Ai-text DEtection
items.description: The easy access to Large Language Models (LLMs) has made AI-generated texts on the web increasingly ubiquitous, making AI-text detection a crucial task.
items.ai_summary: SPADE is a soft prompt framework for AI-text detection that measures prompt influence using pointwise mutual information to achieve robust out-of-distribution performance.

items.title: STEALTH: Steganographic Text Encoding Agnostic to Low-Level Tensor Hardware
items.description: Provably secure linguistic steganography hides a message inside text sampled from a language model, so that without the key, a stegotext is computationally indistinguishable from an honest model sample.
items.ai_summary: STEALTH is a linguistic steganography scheme that uses keyed pseudorandom noise and a rateless spinal code to reliably hide messages across different hardware, precisions, and models.

items.title: Report of the 8th LSVOS Challenge: Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding
items.description: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding (MUMU) track of the 8th Large-scale Video Object Segmentation (LSVOS) Challenge, held in conjunction with ECCV 2026.
items.ai_summary: This report summarizes the Mobile Unified Multimodal Understanding track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge, evaluating compact models that jointly perform image tagging, open-vocabulary detection, and captioning.

items.title: Beyond Word Error Rate: A Failure Taxonomy of Streaming Dictation ASR
items.description: Speech recognition (ASR) systems are usually compared by word error rate (WER) on recorded files, after punctuation, capital letters and number format are removed.
items.ai_summary: This paper proposes a failure taxonomy for streaming dictation ASR systems, analyzing how different models fail across whispered, non-English, and multi-language inputs.

items.title: CADET: Construction of PCB Routing Instances with Executable Demonstrations
items.description: Printed circuit board (PCB) routing is the stage of physical layout that finds paths connecting the placed pads of each net.
items.ai_summary: CADET is an automated framework that jointly generates synthetic printed circuit boards and electronic design automation demonstrations to train reinforcement learning policies for PCB routing.

items.title: Automated PD-L1 Tumor Proportion Scoring with Uncertainty-Guided Triage in Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
items.description: Programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) tumor proportion score (TPS) informs immunotherapy selection in non-small cell lung cancer. Near the 1% and 50% cutoffs, the score should also indicate when closer review is warranted.
items.ai_summary: This uncertainty-guided framework automates PD-L1 tumor proportion scoring in non-small cell lung cancer by combining cell counting with triage mechanisms for ambiguous cases.

items.title: Factored One-sided Adam-Moment for Practical and Scalable SOAP
items.description: FOAM is a lightweight SOAP variant that uses input-only preconditioning and a factored Adam-moment estimator to match strong second-order and Muon baselines in LLM pre-training while using half the optimizer state and running at Muon-class speed.

items.title: Uncertainty-aware quantum machine learning based on Dempster-Shafer theory
items.description: A large body of work in quantum machine learning has centered on characterizing the expressivity and performance of quantum models. In contrast, little attention has been paid to the reliability of predictions beyond average performance measures such as accuracy.
items.ai_summary: This quantum classification framework applies Dempster-Shafer theory to enable parameterized quantum circuits to learn and express prediction uncertainty directly from data.

items.title: TokenStream: Multi-Subject Personalized Video Generation with Token-wise LoRA and Guided Attention
items.description: We introduce TokenStream, an optimization-based framework that composes independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation without a reference-video training dataset or joint optimization of each new subject combination.
items.ai_summary: TokenStream is an optimization-based framework using token-wise LoRA and guided attention to compose independently learned subject identities in text-to-video generation.

items.title: Human or Synthetic? What a Fixed Budget Buys for Post-Training
items.description: Post-training of large language models typically combines supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with preference-based fine-tuning such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
items.ai_summary: This study compares human and synthetic preference data for large language model post-training under a fixed budget, finding synthetic data to be more cost-efficient.

items.title: Look It Up: Multi-bit LLM Watermarking via Codebook Search
items.description: Attributing short LLM-generated texts to a specific source remains challenging for existing multi-bit watermarking methods, which often require long generations or costly decoding to recover payloads reliably.
items.ai_summary: This codebook-based watermarking scheme embeds multi-bit payloads into LLM-generated texts via token-level logit biasing to enable reliable attribution for short generations.

items.title: LLM-Assisted Verification in Dafny
items.description: Formal verification of complex algorithms requires expertise in program specification, invariant construction, mathematical proof, and the management of automated theorem provers.
items.ai_summary: Systematic workflow for LLM-assisted verification that uses automated testing and verification feedback to help developers formally verify complex scientific algorithms.

items.title: Pretraining Data Statistics Shape the Phases of Learning Entity Comparison in Language Models
items.description: How does data shape language model (LM) behavior throughout pretraining? We investigate this question through a case study on entity comparison, e.g., Between France and Brazil, which country is larger?, across nine comparison tasks spanning five entity types.
items.ai_summary: Case study analyzing how data statistics shape three distinct learning phases of entity comparison in language models during pretraining.

items.title: Protein Language Models Fail To Capture Contact Predictions Under Invariant Relabeling
items.description: Protein language models (pLMs) produce highly accurate contact maps from single-sequence inputs.
items.ai_summary: Diagnostic framework that uses an alphabet relabeling transformation to reveal that protein language models rely on explicit residue identities rather than coevolutionary statistics.

items.title: Context Graph: Explainable Multi-Agent Decision Chains in AI-RAN
items.description: AI-RAN distributes network control across multiple autonomous agents, namely xApps and rApps operating over shared radio resources.
items.ai_summary: Context Graph is a heterogeneous directed graph that organizes policies, measurements, and decisions into a queryable layer to enable explainable multi-agent decision chains in AI-RAN.

items.title: Stochastic Kernel Mode Decomposition: Information, Uncertainty, and Conditional Regime Inference
items.description: When do mode energies preserve regime information as measurement quality changes? Stochastic Kernel Mode Decomposition (sKMD) fits joint regime laws on signed KMD mode coordinates and transfers the reference mode posterior to regime probabilities and conditional reconstructions.
items.ai_summary: Stochastic Kernel Mode Decomposition is a method that fits joint regime laws on KMD mode coordinates to transfer reference mode posteriors to regime probabilities and conditional reconstructions.

items.title: DPA: Decentralized Primal Averaging with Quasi-Global Momentum for Highly Heterogeneous Data
items.description: Decentralized training of deep learning models keeps training data local and supports on-device learning over networks.
items.ai_summary: Decentralized Primal Averaging is a decentralized learning algorithm that combines primal averaging with a local quasi-global momentum buffer to improve training on heterogeneous data.

items.title: Raysemble: Metric 3D Bone Reconstruction from a Single X-ray
items.description: Raysemble reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement. Each 3D query samples regional and global features at its image projection. A shared decoder predicts normalized bone shapes.
items.ai_summary: Raysemble is a method that reconstructs eight lumbar and pelvic bones from a single X-ray by separating shape and placement to sample regional and global features.

items.title: Visual Cipher Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Reasoning
items.description: While language-model agents excel at long-horizon coding and terminal tasks, this success relies on two conditions: explicit text specifications and immediate execution feedback.
items.ai_summary: Visual Cipher Bench is a collection of 40 original visual puzzles used to benchmark language-model agents on long-horizon visual reasoning and puzzle-solving tasks.

items.title: hitkeeen/blender-ai-mcp-addon
items.description: AI assistant and MCP server for Blender: visual chat, scene tools, multi-agent workflows. Works with ChatGPT/GPT, Claude, Gemini, Ollama, OpenCode. Blender AI addon, copilot for 3D, bpy Python scripting, MCP integration.
items.ai_summary: Hitkeeen mcp-for-blender-pro is an AI assistant and MCP server for Blender that enables scene inspection, object creation, material editing, and multi-step workflows.

items.title: Sustainable Federated Fine-Tuning with LoRA: Environmental Impact and Performance Footprint
items.description: Federated Learning (FL) with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its energy and carbon costs across hardware remain poorly understood.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation framework assessing the energy and carbon costs of federated Low-Rank Adaptation fine-tuning for large language models across different hardware and configurations.

items.title: Shortcuts or Memorisation? Revisiting Data Corruption in Natural Language Understanding with Large Language Models
items.description: Pre-trained encoders fine-tuned on natural language inference (NLI) and other language understanding tasks keep much of their accuracy after the input is perturbed, e.g. by removing all nouns or shuffling the words.
items.ai_summary: Study revisiting data perturbation experiments on natural language models to show that robustness to input perturbation on familiar benchmarks reflects dataset shortcuts rather than training memorisation.

items.title: Kosmo-GFM: A Production-Ready Geometry Foundation Model
items.description: We present Kosmo-GFM, a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model (GFM), a pose optimization engine (PoseEngine), and reconstruction-derived supervision from KosmoWorld.
items.ai_summary: Kosmo-GFM is a scene reconstruction system that integrates a geometry foundation model, a pose optimization engine, and reconstruction-derived supervision to recover camera poses and geometry for 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting.

items.title: A Modular Framework for ESG Prediction through Domain-Specific Language Modeling and Graph Learning
items.description: Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) scores are increasingly used to evaluate corporate sustainability, supporting investment decisions, ensuring regulatory compliance and assessing risk.
items.ai_summary: ESGPred is a modular prediction framework that combines domain-specific language modeling with graph-based relational learning over company networks to improve the accuracy of corporate sustainability and ESG score predictions.

items.title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation of open-weight models on medical QA benchmarks reveals that temperature scaling effectively removes raw probability overconfidence while split conformal prediction achieves nominal coverage at the cost of large prediction sets.

items.title: Outcome-Mass Alignment: Controlling Length-Dependent Trajectory Influence in Multi-Turn LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
items.description: To keep long interaction contexts tractable, stepwise group-relative training for multi-turn LLM agents materializes each source trajectory into multiple response rows and valid tokens.
items.ai_summary: Outcome-Mass Alignment is a two-component training method for multi-turn LLM agents that controls outcome-statistics multiplicity and objective-mass imbalance to improve endpoint success rates.

items.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
items.description: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset.
items.ai_summary: PREWARN is an evaluation protocol for language model failure monitors that calibrates thresholds on validation data and scores alarms relative to annotated failure onsets across multiple tasks.

items.title: KuaiRecV2: Benchmarking Large-Scale Continual Learning for Diversified and Multi-task Recommendation
items.description: Recommender systems, which retrieve items of interest to users based on their interaction histories, have recently witnessed several key technological advancements, benefiting from the semantic representation space and model-data scaling.
items.ai_summary: KuaiRecV2 is a large-scale recommendation benchmark featuring multi-modal item data and long-term interactions to help address continual learning, combinatorial diversity, and multi-task reward balancing challenges.

items.title: EG360: Efficient and Generalizable $360^\circ$ Depth Estimation via Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation and Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion
items.description: Generalized panorama depth estimation has witnessed great advances in recent years.
items.ai_summary: EG360 is an efficient and generalizable panorama depth estimation model that combines an adaptive panorama-perspective distillation strategy with a spherical cross-level feature fusion module for real-time edge device inference.

items.title: Systematic Evaluation of Training Data Generation Strategies for Machine Learning-Based Molecular and Materials Property Prediction
items.description: Machine-learning (ML) models for molecular and materials property prediction are often trained on large datasets curated through arbitrary or generic sampling strategies.
items.ai_summary: Systematic evaluation of training data acquisition strategies for molecular and materials property prediction shows that uncertainty-based active learning generally outperforms random sampling across diverse model classes and datasets.

items.title: ScrewSense: Mapping the Invisible - Anomaly Detection and Error Classification in Screwdriving Processes
items.description: The growing volume of process data generated by screwdriving systems, combined with advancements in computing power, data storage, and algorithms, is facilitating the application of artificial intelligence in this field.
items.ai_summary: Deep learning techniques using vector quantized variational autoencoders and multivariate time series data successfully detect anomalies and classify errors in industrial screwdriving processes with high accuracy.

items.title: Class-Competence Aggregation: Output-Layer Routing for Federated Multiclass DDoS Detection under Class-Concentrated Non-IID Data
items.description: Federated learning over distributed intrusion-detection sensors naturally produces \emph{class-concentrated} non-IID data, where an entire attack class is held by a single client and absent elsewhere.
items.ai_summary: Class-Competence Aggregation is an output-layer routing method for federated learning that uses client validation performance to aggregate classes separately, successfully preventing the collapse of concentrated attack classes in DDoS detection.

items.title: Evaluating Video LLMs' Understanding of Corner Cases in Autonomous Driving
items.description: Natural language explanations promised by modern Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) offer autonomous driving systems a path toward detailed scene description and interpretable decision making on the road.
items.ai_summary: DashBench is a benchmark testing 25 video language models on 1,709 driving videos to evaluate corner case understanding in autonomous driving systems.

items.title: Efficient Periocular Recognition through Model Scaling and Cross Spectral VIS NIR Verification
items.description: Periocular recognition offers an efficient alternative to full-face verification when facial regions are occluded or image resolution is limited.
items.ai_summary: AdaEye is a systematic study of input and backbone scaling for periocular verification that reduces computational costs and increases inference throughput.

items.title: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
items.description: Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes.
items.ai_summary: A supervised learning framework classifies adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables to improve early risk detection.

items.title: AgriSense: Vision-Language Decision Support and Robotic Intervention in a Virtual Greenhouse Copy title
items.description: Autonomous greenhouse management increasingly requires robotic systems that integrate perception, navigation, environmental regulation, and plant-level intervention.
items.ai_summary: AgriSense is a virtual greenhouse framework combining a quadruped mobile manipulator, multimodal sensing, and vision-language decision support for autonomous agricultural management.

items.title: Interpretable machine learning diagnosis of degradation mechanisms in lead-free $RbSn_{0.5}Ge_{0.5}I_{3}$ solar cells from temperature- and illumination-dependent electrical measurements
items.description: Machine learning coupled with device simulation is widely used to optimize thin-film solar cells, but almost exclusively in the forward direction, from device parameters to predicted performance.
items.ai_summary: A multi-label classifier identifies degradation mechanisms in lead-free solar cells from simulated temperature- and illumination-dependent electrical measurements.

items.title: ORCA:Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment for Multi-View Clustering
items.description: Deep multi-view clustering often suffers from redundant information accumulation during fusion and indiscriminate alignment across representation levels. We propose Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment (ORCA) to address these challenges.
items.ai_summary: Orthogonal Residual Consensus Alignment is a deep multi-view clustering method that extracts cross-view orthogonal residuals to balance view-specific structure with cross-view consistency.

items.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.description: PhysLoop leverages large language models to guide video generation, selection, and correction, enabling physically consistent self-improvement and controllable data construction for video models.

items.title: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift in Visual Prompt Injection Against VLMs and Web Agents
items.description: Visual content in multimedia systems may be resized, compressed, or re-rendered before it is interpreted by a vision-language model.
items.ai_summary: Scale-Induced Semantic Shift is a security failure mode in vision-language models where image transformations alter machine-readable semantics, enabling visual prompt injection attacks.

items.title: Fog-FWL: A Large-Scale Full-Waveform LiDAR Dataset for Recovering Fog-Hidden Objects
items.description: LiDAR is a core sensor for autonomous driving, yet it is highly vulnerable to fog.
items.ai_summary: Fog-FWL is a large-scale full-waveform LiDAR dataset containing real and synthetic foggy scenes to support recovering objects hidden by fog in autonomous driving.

items.title: Gondola doubles revenue as its team builds more with Codex
items.description: Gondola helps creatives get credit and get hired, with Codex raising its lead engineer’s output by 50% and ChatGPT simplifying daily work.
items.ai_summary: Gondola doubled its revenue while utilizing OpenAI's Codex to raise its lead engineer's output by 50 percent and ChatGPT to simplify daily work.

items.title: IluvatarLabs/sitrep
items.description: One live console to monitor Claude Code and Codex agents across machines, track context and spend, and unblock sessions that need you.
items.ai_summary: Sitrep is a live console designed to monitor Claude Code and Codex agents across multiple machines, track resource usage, and unblock sessions.

items.title: zenteiq-research/scirex
items.description: JAX/Flax neural operators for scientific machine learning, with benchmarks and pretrained weights.
items.ai_summary: ScireX is a JAX-native library of neural operators for scientific machine learning, used for PDE solving, surrogate modeling, and multi-scale physical systems.

items.title: jackson-cmd/risk-aware-trading-agents
items.description: AI trading agents for US stocks with news backtesting that can't see the future: a point-in-time 2026 dataset (prices, VIX, news), a look-ahead check on every run, LLM agents over MCP, FOMC/CPI/VIX-aware regimes, and paper/live trading on 10 brokers. 风险感知美股交易智能体 · 新闻回测
items.ai_summary: AI trading agents for US stocks that incorporate macro calendars, news backtesting, and risk management tools to execute paper or live trades.

items.title: WorldDraft: If Code Builds the World, Can Video Models Just Render It?
items.description: Multimodal coding agents decouple 4D world construction from visual generation, repurposing video models from world generators toward generative renderers. This division of labor raises a fundamental question: if code builds the world, can video models just render it?

items.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
items.description: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation.

items.title: From Large Language Models to Efficient System One Models via Adaptive Computation
items.description: Transferring LLMs into System One decision models typically replaces the language modeling head with a decision head while retaining the full backbone, making every decision pay for all layers. Yet it remains unclear how much depth such decisions require.

items.title: molly554/whiteboard-ai-tutor
items.description: Open-source AI tutor that teaches on a whiteboard. Benchmark of 6 LLMs (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek): 288 lessons drawn stroke by stroke, blind-reviewed. 白板 AI 导师 / AI 老师讲课评测
items.ai_summary: Open-source AI tutor and benchmark that teaches lessons by streaming drawing instructions as JSON to a whiteboard player in the browser.

items.title: fendouai/ViralForge
items.description: Agent-native viral video studio: one-click replicate viral short videos, deconstruct video hooks and scripts into a Viral DNA report, and ship 10 costed variants. Skill + MCP + CLI. Apache-2.0.
items.ai_summary: Agent-native viral video studio that deconstructs short videos into a structured report and generates editable project variants for A/B testing.

items.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models

items.ai_summary: Microsoft researchers discovered a backdoor technique called Lazarus that can reprogram dormant neurons in an AI model to execute malicious commands.
